- great ambiance - limited wifi (2 hr voucher) their matcha is okay, not too bitter. not the best, but its reasonably priced considering that it's big in size. their biscoff cream waffles are good too.

October 6 and 8, 2024 were one of the only active dates I've had for dining in Kapenato's second floor area. I spent most of my time when going to that building at Elixr Coffee which is now the area occupied as Kapenato's first floor. Most of the orders I got were waffles and sandwiches and I recall getting a ₱200 aglio olio pasta which I remembered used angel hair pasta so it does not make your stomach full. Then, I would get cookies and cream milk teas. Some portions can get smaller especially at rice meals then you look at the price.

Didn't get to order coffee due to time constraints, but we did order rice meals. I had their creamy pork mushroom, and I highly commend its exquisite taste. The ambiance was also good with proper airconditioning. The restroom was clean too! I love how quiet it was during our stay. Will defo come back soon to try their coffee.
Good ambiance and well-designed space. Best for meeting place. You can chill while working your stuffs. ✨

This experience is with my girl friends, the place is nice but not too nice when went that day. 3 stars for the food, neutral honest and no biased, we ordered waffle creemcheese (wrong for me i expected the creemcheese spreads to the waffle but it wasn't. Not what I wanted, I just wanted it to be spread like that. 3 stars service, it was okay that we waited more than 20-30 mins because we ordered a lot. What we didn't get, we asked for paper and pen for us to just list to help the crew with our order, because aside from the increasing number of customers we ordered a lot. Guess what my friend repeated to me that our orders were in fact written on the paper we gave us and it was clear when we wrote it. Guess, what he made a mistake in the order. But still since we already paid we just split the payment for the wrong order. Atmosphere? 3 stars only because the crew was very polite (i don't know maybe she was having a bad day or she was in a bad mood) we felt that vibe from her and We also heard a pretty loud banging of the equipment while he was working. So, we really felt like we weren't welcome. Hahahahaha Anyways. The drinks we ordered were good, we were able to drink them. Just be happy and God bless! More customers to come! That's all I hope next time we won't feel that way.
The best cafe in Mintal. Their waffles and coffee are delicious. I recommend them to everyone.
